claim_boundary.not_claimed: A trade, profit, or monthly 3x return at every time. Market opportunity is conditional and losses remain possible.
claim_boundary.existence_claim: The exact EUR_USD SHORT BREAKOUT_FAILURE LIMIT attached-TP vehicle has positive realized after-bid/ask evidence in the frozen historical receipts.

vehicle.bar_contract: completed body close confirms the failed breakout; wick high defines the sweep and LIMIT/TP/SL first-touch uses side-correct bid/ask

negative_controls: missing evidence returns WAIT, never an assumed TRADE
mid-price or inverted bid/ask returns WAIT
body-only touch cannot replace broker wick touch
sample count below 20 cannot create forward permission
all-time profit and validation-best parameter are forbidden claims
